_about: Copper science page before/after card images with ingredient-named filenames (Malcolm, 2026-09-26: 'at least 2 sections that show the best proven results from studies - with a before and after image'). From ~/Desktop/skingenetix-before-after-copper-cards-r1.png, Malcolm's picks: card f1 = A2 gpt_image 01 (slot cub1--copper-crowsfeet-a, Badenhorst 2016 crow's feet, her right side = the trial's treated side), card f2 = E2 gpt_image 01 (slot cub1--copper-facecream-e, the 2002 face-cream study, 71 women). Checked at full size: same woman in each pair (temple mole / cheek mole match), same side, plain walls, no text or watermark, no white frame, no divider. Noted for the record: A2's change looks larger than the trial's quarter and the skin under the eye also smooths; E2's right panel is a little brighter (white wall). E2 kept uncropped: the card needs a square master and the cheek and jaw already fill most of it. Copied (not renamed) from the wave so the candidates keep their names.
